title: Nonempty clauses in the seed formula
statement: Let $V$ be a nonadaptive verifier with Boolean input alphabet, input length $n$, proof length $p$, and $r>0$ query positions, and let $s$ be one of its seeds. Every clause occurring in the associated padded seed CNF on $r+r2^r$ coordinates has positive width.
